_note: 特殊句構未覆蓋 KP 補建：同位語 apposition（eng.t_adv.special.apposition，學測級）。同位語＝放在某名詞旁、用來重新命名或說明它的名詞（片語）；非必要（補充說明）同位語用逗號前後隔開：Tom, my brother, is a doctor.；必要（限定、用來指明是哪一個）同位語不加逗號：My friend Lisa / the writer George Orwell。同位語與被說明的名詞指同一人/物、通常可整個拿掉句子仍成立。防第二正解：distractor 用逗號缺漏、把同位語寫成含動詞的子句（who/is）、限定 vs 非限定逗號誤用鎖唯一解。皆標準英語，以 Swan/Oxford，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。文法單元無音檔。

units.title_zh: 同位語（Tom, my brother, is a doctor.）
units.can_do: 我能用同位語——放在某名詞旁、用來重新命名或進一步說明它的名詞（片語）；知道補充說明（非必要）的同位語要用逗號前後隔開，而用來指明「是哪一個」（必要）的同位語不加逗號；同位語與原名詞指同一人或同一物，通常可整個拿掉而句子仍成立。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: An appositive is a noun or noun phrase placed right after another noun to rename or explain it; a non-essential (extra-information) appositive is set off by commas: 'Tom, my brother, is a doctor.'
claims.verification_ref: 同位語＝緊接名詞之後、重新命名/說明該名詞的名詞片語；補充說明者前後加逗號；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The appositive and the noun it follows refer to the same person or thing, so a non-essential appositive can be removed and the sentence still works: 'Tom, my brother, is a doctor' -> 'Tom is a doctor.'
claims.verification_ref: 同位語與原名詞同指一人/物，非必要同位語可整個拿掉仍成句；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When the appositive is essential to show which one is meant, no commas are used: 'My friend Lisa called,' 'the writer George Orwell.'
claims.verification_ref: 必要（限定）同位語用來指明是哪一個時不加逗號；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: An appositive is a noun or noun phrase, not a verb clause: say 'Mr. Lee, our new teacher, is kind,' not 'Mr. Lee, who our new teacher, is kind' and not 'Mr. Lee, is our new teacher, is kind.'
claims.verification_ref: 同位語是名詞片語非含動詞的子句；不加 who、不重複 is；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: An appositive is a noun (or noun phrase) placed right after another noun to rename or explain it. When it just adds extra information, we set it off with a comma before and after: Tom, my brother, is a doctor.
teach.zh_hint: 同位語是緊接在某個名詞後面、用來重新命名或說明那個名詞的名詞（片語）。當它只是補充說明時，前後各加一個逗號：Tom, my brother, is a doctor.（湯姆，我哥哥，是個醫生。）

teach.body: Paris, the capital of France, is famous for the Eiffel Tower.
teach.zh_hint: 巴黎，法國的首都，以艾菲爾鐵塔聞名。the capital of France 是同位語，前後用逗號隔開。

teach.body: The appositive and the noun point to the same person or thing, so an extra-information appositive can be removed and the sentence still works: 'Tom, my brother, is a doctor' still makes sense as 'Tom is a doctor.'
teach.zh_hint: 同位語和它後面所說明的名詞指同一人或同一物，所以「補充說明」的同位語可以整個拿掉、句子仍然成立：Tom, my brother, is a doctor 拿掉後 Tom is a doctor 仍成句。

teach.body: My neighbor, a kind old man, feeds the street cats every morning.
teach.zh_hint: 我的鄰居，一位和善的老先生，每天早上餵街貓。a kind old man 是同位語，重新說明 my neighbor。

teach.body: When the appositive is needed to show exactly which one you mean, use no commas: 'My friend Lisa won the race' (you have several friends, so the name is essential); 'the writer George Orwell.'
teach.zh_hint: 當同位語是用來指明「究竟是哪一個」、不可省略時，就不加逗號：My friend Lisa won the race（你有好幾個朋友，名字是必要資訊）；the writer George Orwell（作家喬治‧歐威爾）。

teach.body: Remember that an appositive is a noun phrase, not a clause: say 'Mr. Lee, our new teacher, is very kind,' not 'Mr. Lee, who our new teacher, is very kind.'
teach.zh_hint: 記得同位語是名詞片語，不是含動詞的子句：要說 Mr. Lee, our new teacher, is very kind（李老師，我們的新老師，人很好），不要說 ×Mr. Lee, who our new teacher, is very kind（多了 who、少了動詞）。

practice.stem: 把同位語 my best friend 加進 Anna helped me，哪一句標點正確？（補充說明，非必要資訊）
practice.answer: Anna, my best friend, helped me.
options: Anna, my best friend, helped me.
Anna my best friend helped me.
Anna, my best friend helped me.
Anna is my best friend helped me.

補充說明的同位語前後都要有逗號，這句一個逗號都沒有。
只有前面一個逗號；非必要同位語前後各需一個逗號（…friend, helped）。
同位語是名詞片語，不是加動詞的子句；加了 is 變成兩個動詞（is、helped），不成句。

practice.feedback: 補充說明的同位語前後各一個逗號：Anna, my best friend, helped me.

practice.stem: 在 My neighbor, a kind old man, feeds the cats. 這句裡，哪一部分是同位語？
options: a kind old man
My neighbor
feeds the cats
the cats

distractor_rationales.My neighbor: My neighbor 是被說明的主詞名詞，不是同位語；同位語是用來重新說明它的 a kind old man。
distractor_rationales.feeds the cats: feeds the cats 是動詞片語（述語），不是同位語（同位語是名詞片語）。
distractor_rationales.the cats: the cats 是動詞的受詞，不是用來重新命名 my neighbor 的同位語。

practice.feedback: a kind old man 緊接 my neighbor、重新說明同一個人，就是同位語。

practice.stem: 你有三個哥哥，想特別說名叫 Sam 的那一個是飛行員（名字是必要、用來指明是哪一個）。哪一句正確？
practice.answer: My brother Sam is a pilot.
options: My brother Sam is a pilot.
My brother, Sam, is a pilot.
My brother Sam, is a pilot.
My, brother Sam is a pilot.

加逗號會暗示你只有一個哥哥、Sam 只是補充；但你有三個哥哥，名字是必要資訊，必須不加逗號。
只在後面放一個逗號，前後不對稱；必要同位語根本不加逗號。
逗號放錯位置（My 後面），不符任何同位語用法。

practice.feedback: 名字是用來指明哪一個哥哥（必要資訊），不加逗號：My brother Sam is a pilot.

practice.stem: 哪一句的同位語形式正確？（李老師，我們的新老師，人很好）
practice.answer: Mr. Lee, our new teacher, is very kind.
options: Mr. Lee, our new teacher, is very kind.
Mr. Lee, who our new teacher, is very kind.
Mr. Lee, is our new teacher, is very kind.
Mr. Lee our new teacher, is very kind.

distractor_rationales.Mr. Lee, who our new teacher, is very ki: 同位語是名詞片語，不用 who；加了 who 又沒有動詞，不成句。
distractor_rationales.Mr. Lee, is our new teacher, is very kin: 同位語不含動詞；加了 is 會出現兩個 is，變成兩個述語。
缺少前面的逗號；補充說明的同位語前後各需一個逗號。

practice.feedback: 同位語是名詞片語、前後加逗號、不加 who/動詞：Mr. Lee, our new teacher, is very kind.

practice.stem: 把同位語 the tallest mountain in the world 加進 Mount Everest attracts many climbers.，哪一句正確？
practice.answer: Mount Everest, the tallest mountain in the world, attracts many climbers.
options: Mount Everest, the tallest mountain in the world, attracts many climbers.
Mount Everest the tallest mountain in the world attracts many climbers.
Mount Everest, the tallest mountain in the world attracts many climbers.
Mount Everest is the tallest mountain in the world attracts many climbers.

distractor_rationales.Mount Everest the tallest mountain in th: 補充說明的同位語前後都要逗號，這句完全沒有逗號。
distractor_rationales.Mount Everest, the tallest mountain in t: 只有前面一個逗號，少了同位語後面那個逗號（…world, attracts）。
distractor_rationales.Mount Everest is the tallest mountain in: 加 is 變成含動詞的子句又接 attracts，出現兩個述語；同位語只是名詞片語。

practice.feedback: 同位語前後各一個逗號：Mount Everest, the tallest mountain in the world, attracts many climbers.

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀＋語調模仿：看句子朗讀→自評（不自動判讀發音）。同位語（兩個逗號之間）語調略降、稍放慢，像插入的補充說明，念完回到主句語調。

lines.text: My sister, a nurse at the city hospital, works very long hours.
lines.intonation: a nurse at the city hospital 兩逗號間語調略降、稍慢，主句 works very long hours 回正常語調、句尾下收

lines.text: The novel Animal Farm was written by George Orwell.
lines.intonation: Animal Farm 必要同位語不停頓、與 novel 連讀，by George Orwell 句尾下收
